en.title: Accessibility Digest: Gaming, Tech, Transit, Policy, and SEO Highlights – May 12, 2026
en.summary: Today's digest highlights Blizzard's discussion of accessibility features in Diablo game design, Xiaomi HyperOS introducing a Clarity Mode for senior users, Nairobi's commuter rail modernization improving accessibility, the HHS OCR delaying enforcement of Section 504 digital accessibility requirements, and how optimizing page accessibility can enhance SEO crawl budget.
